review_candidates.title: Lead DevOps Engineer (Azure)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: What You'll Be Doing Design, build and maintain scalable Azure infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code . Design and maintain Azure networking, including VNets, hub-and-spoke architectures, DNS, NSGs and firewall solutions. Develop and maintain Helm charts and standardised deployment processes for application teams. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines . Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Role: Lead DevOps Engineer (Azure) Location: Remote, UK Salary: £85,000 + bonus Key Skills: Azure (Azure Landing Zones) AKS GitOps (ArgoCD) Terraform The Role: This is a hands-on senior engineering position with plenty of scope to influence technical direction, improve engineering standards and help shape the way cloud infrastructure is designed and delivered. We're looking for someone who can operate independently, get hands-on with complex technical challenges and confidently contribute to architectural discussions. Proficiency with Python, Bash or similar scripting languages .
